# Carolina Skin Centre

> Facials, HydraFacial and skin care in Midland, Texas, by a licensed esthetician with 18+ years of experience. Serving Midland, Odessa and the Permian Basin.

Carolina Skin Centre is a skin care studio at 705 W Wadley Ave Suite 23, Midland, TX 79705. Phone: (432) 638-0046. Open Tuesday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Se habla español.

## Services

- [HydraFacial in Midland, TX](https://www.carolinaskincentre.com/services/hydrafacial-midland-tx): Deep cleansing, exfoliation, extractions and hydration in one treatment.
- [Customized Facials in Midland, TX](https://www.carolinaskincentre.com/services/facials-midland-tx): Facials tailored to your skin. The Signature Skin facial is 60 minutes and $120; add-ons cost extra.
- [Nano-Needling in Midland, TX](https://www.carolinaskincentre.com/services/nano-needling-midland-tx): Ultra-fine nano needles create microscopic channels that help skin absorb treatment products.
- [Dermaplaning in Midland, TX](https://www.carolinaskincentre.com/services/dermaplaning-midland-tx): Exfoliation that removes dead skin and fine facial hair.
- [Lash Tinting in Midland, TX](https://www.carolinaskincentre.com/services/lash-tinting-midland-tx): Semi-permanent tint that darkens natural lashes; no extensions.
- [All services](https://www.carolinaskincentre.com/services): Overview of the five treatments.
